% 02 solution-01
\begin{tikzpicture}[x=.95cm,y=.95cm]
  \begin{scope}
    \draw[axis] (-.2,0)--(6.2,0) node[right]{$t$};
    \draw[axis] (0,-2.2)--(0,3.2) node[above]{速度};
    \draw[blue!70!black,very thick] (0,2.5)--(3.2,.8)--(5.8,.8) node[right]{$u$};
    \draw[red!70!black,very thick] (0,-1.4)--(3.2,.8)--(5.8,.8) node[right]{$\omega r$};
    \draw[guide] (3.2,-2)--(3.2,2.8);
    \node[below] at (3.2,0){首次纯滚动};
  \end{scope}
  \begin{scope}[shift={(8.1,0)}]
    \draw[body] (-2.2,0) circle(1.1); \draw[body] (1.0,0) circle(1.1);
    \draw[impulse] (-2.2,0)--(-1.1,0) node[midway,above]{$0.1u_c$};
    \draw[impulse] (-2.2,-1.45)--(-3.6,-1.45) node[midway,below]{回滚};
    \draw[flow,purple!70!black] ($(-2.2,0)+(30:.7)$) arc[start angle=30,end angle=310,radius=.7] node[right]{反旋};
    \node[align=center] at (-.6,-2.5){碰撞必须发生在首次纯滚动之前\\碰后用 $u+\frac25r\omega$ 判断最终方向};
  \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
